review.body_prefix: Thanks for hardening the Mouse Without Borders Settings IPC path. Three localized fixes are included as inline suggestions below; the accepted-only process verification cache is a separate multi-region companion note.

proposed_comments.title: Honor cached revocation when verifying the peer signer

confidence.rationale: The current RIGHT-side code explicitly sets X509RevocationMode.NoCheck. The validated replacement uses cached/offline revocation, rejects known revocation, tolerates only unavailable revocation information, and passed the targeted 23-test Settings IPC security run.

proposed_comments.title: Back off rejected clients and throttle both retry log paths

confidence.rationale: The current added server loop immediately continues after rejection and logs every rejection and exception. The validated replacement adds cancellation-aware rejection backoff and independent 30-second throttles; targeted MWB IPC tests passed and the final review was clean.

proposed_comments.title: Cache only accepted peer verification results by process instance

confidence.rationale: NamedPipePeerVerification.TryVerifyPeerProcess currently reaches MeetsSigningPolicy on every accepted reconnect. The validated design keys successful results by PID, process creation time, and identity-policy inputs, stores only accepted results, and removes rejected keys.

proposed_comments.body:
### Cache only accepted peer verification results by process instance

**Severity:** `medium`

`TryVerifyPeerProcess` performs the full executable and signer verification on every accepted reconnect (`NamedPipePeerVerification.cs`, current lines 95–180, including `MeetsSigningPolicy` at line 173). Please cache successful verification by PID plus process creation time and the expected identity inputs, while never retaining rejected results. This is a multi-region change (imports and static state, the verification flow, helpers, and key or result records), so it is intentionally a general companion note rather than a partial inline suggestion.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The accepted-only verification cache requires coordinated edits across the class-level cache declarations, process-verification flow, cache helper methods, and cache-key/result record declarations; no single current RIGHT-side range contains a safe self-contained replacement.

proposed_comments.title: Keep generated certificate fixtures inside issuer validity

confidence.rationale: The current RIGHT-side helpers independently evaluate UtcNow for issuer and child expiration, so the child can outlive its issuer by a fraction of a second. The validated replacement derives each notAfter from the issuer and the targeted Settings IPC suite passed 23 of 23 tests.
